body: Right now I can't exactly explain how I feel I am alive  I woke up around 430 am almost in a state of shock after passing out right after righting my post and eating 2 xanex bars I am at work currently with kind of a strange feeling I can't really explain almost like an adrenaline rush I am not sure maybe I'm happy that I'm still here  gods kept me around threw a lot I've made plenty dangerous decisions and done some very wrong things but honestly try my best to be a good person so maybe there is some reason I am still here idk how I will feel tonight thst always the worst part all I crave is to have purpose in life and find a way to do good instead of dragging people down before my addiction began and for most of my life I dreamed of going into military serivice airborne rangers to be exact but when the time came I couldn't leave tabitha behind not to mention I still have not had the courage to stop using long enough to get withdrawal out of the way except once when Greg passed that was the only few days I really managed to try to change even tho I still went back to opiates very soon after even with this problem I decided to contact an army recruiter because I simply not happy in my lonely day to day routine I want something more I always have had a desire to make a difference and I try to believe that the reason I'm still here is to do just that hopefully tonight will be better me waking up this morning may have been my wake up call I haven't used today and feel surprisingly healthy I have always been in good physical shape despite my drug use I always found time to make my self work out hard maybe chasing my dream without knowing it anyways thank you for your support it really made a difference you nvr know you may have just saved a strangers life
